title: U.S. Debt Tops $40 Trillion: Borrowing Costs and Mortgage Rates
description:
The @MarksEconomics debt warning raises a practical question: what does federal borrowing mean for your mortgage and savings? We unpack the channel’s 2026 claims of $40 trillion in debt, more than $1 trillion in annual interest and a 5.3% Treasury auction yield, clearly labeled as unverified channel claims. Then we explain its account of retreating Treasury buyers, higher term premiums and buybacks offering limited relief. We connect Treasury yields to mortgage costs, separate higher bond yields from falling resale prices, and explain why cash needs and affordable payments matter more than panic trades.

For entertainment and informational purposes only. This is not financial, legal, medical, or other professional advice. Consult a qualified professional about your circumstances. We are not responsible for decisions or results based on this video.

#MarksEconomics #MarkTilburyEconomics #USnationaldebtexplained #Housing #RealEstate
